inclusion_criteria: HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer
Disease progression under trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in the metastatic setting
Willing and able to undergo baseline tumor biopsy during the pre‑treatment period
Willing and able to provide blood samples at pre‑specified time points
Willing and able to undergo baseline FDG‑PET/CT imaging
Willing and able to undergo baseline 89Zr‑trastuzumab PET/CT (HER2‑PET/CT) imaging
ECOG performance status ≤ 1

Histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2‑positive breast carcinoma as per ASCO‑CAP guidelines; HER2 status may be determined in the primary tumor or, if unavailable, in a metastatic lesion
Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumors are allowed if all tested HER2‑positive according to local testing
Prior treatment with taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting) and T‑DXd (metastatic setting)
Must have received T‑DXd as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and have disease progression on this drug

Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible provided T‑DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and disease progression on it
Life expectancy ≥ 6 months
At screening FDG‑PET, at least two target lesions are required, each with an anatomic transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm and metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean
Anatomically transaxial diameter of lesion ≤ 1.5 cm
Lesion metabolically assessable with SUVmax ≤ 1.5 × SUVmean + 2 SD of liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter VOI in normal liver parenchyma
For suspected liver metastasis, lesion SUVmax ≤ 2 × SUVmean + 3 SD of blood pool measured in a 1‑cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta
Lesions must not have been pre‑treated with irradiation
Absolute neutrophil count ≥ 1000/µL (or ≥ 1 × 10⁹/L)
Platelet count ≥ 100,000/µL (or ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L)
Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 × ULN or estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 mL/min
Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN unless patient has documented Gilbert syndrome
AST and ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN
Current left ventricular ejection fraction ≥ 50 % on echocardiography or MUGA
No history of LVEF < 40 % or symptomatic heart failure or recent myocardial infarction
Willingness to provide mandatory tumor tissue biopsy and blood samples for translational research
Willingness to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study, including treatment and scheduled visits/examinations
Signed informed consent obtained prior to any study‑related procedure
Affiliated to the French Social Security System (France only)
exclusion_criteria: Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for treatment of metastatic breast cancer
Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for early breast cancer with relapse while on or within 12 months of finishing T‑DM1
Brain metastasis as sole metastasis
Symptomatic brain metastasis or brain metastasis requiring therapy to control symptoms
History of interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis grade 3 or 4 during prior treatment with T‑DXd
Significant cardiopulmonary symptoms grade ≥ 2 relating to left‑ventricular dysfunction, cardiac arrhythmia, or cardiac ischemia while or since receiving preoperative therapy
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic > 180 mmHg and/or diastolic > 100 mmHg)
Inadequately controlled angina, serious cardiac arrhythmia not controlled by medication, severe conduction abnormality, or clinically significant valvular disease
Screening LVEF < 50 % by echocardiography or MUGA
History of NCI CTCAE grade ≥ 3 symptomatic congestive heart failure or NYHA class ≥ II
History of decrease in LVEF to < 40 % or symptomatic CHF with prior trastuzumab treatment
Myocardial infarction within 12 months prior to randomization
Requirement for continuous oxygen therapy
Known prior severe hypersensitivity to the investigational product or any component, including trastuzumab or excipients
Contra‑indication for treatment with T‑DM1
Progression within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy after enrollment of 7 rapid progressors (considered exclusion thereafter)
Progression within the first 6 months of T-DXd therapy after the first 7 rapid progressors have been included
Any known liver disease, including known carriers of hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C, autoimmune hepatic disorders and sclerosing cholangitis
Concurrent, serious, uncontrolled infections or known infection with HIV
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years except basal or squamous cell carcinoma of skin that has been definitively treated
Pregnant and/or lactating women, or intending to become pregnant during the study
Serum pregnancy test positive within 15 days prior to enrolment for subjects of childbearing potential
Women of childbearing potential refusing to use one highly effective method of contraception from ICF signature, during the study and at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1
Men with childbearing potential partner refusing to use a condom during the study and for at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1

Subject with a significant medical, neuro‑psychiatric, or surgical condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that, in the principal investigator's opinion, may interfere with completion of the study

Vulnerable persons according to article L.1121‑6 of the Public Health Code, adults who are the subject of a measure of legal protection or unable to express their consent according to article L.1121‑8 of the Public Health Code (applicable to France only)
